ui_bugs.issue: After deactivating a promo code, the status pill shows 'Degraded' (amber) instead of 'Inactive'. Line 817 passes both ok={pc.active} and warn={!pc.active}, and StatePill (line 71) renders 'Degraded' whenever warn is truthy, overriding labelBad='Inactive'. Fix: pass warn={false} (or drop warn) so an inactive code renders labelBad='Inactive'. Reserve 'Degraded' for coupon.valid===false while active===true.

action_items: Fix Promotions StatePill: after toggle-deactivate, show 'Inactive' (not 'Degraded'). Change ControlCenter.jsx line ~817 to <StatePill ok={pc.active} labelOk="Active" labelBad="Inactive" /> (drop warn), or gate warn on coupon.valid===false && pc.active===true.

rca of the issue: Promotions 'Inactive' shown as 'Degraded': ControlCenter.jsx line 817 sets both ok={pc.active} and warn={!pc.active}. StatePill (line 68-72) prioritizes warn over labelBad, so any promo with active=false always renders the amber 'Degraded' pill. Fix by removing the warn prop or scoping it to coupon.valid===false && pc.active===true.
